title: Packed-weight endianness mismatch & concurrency-triggered crashloop — postmortem & action plan
creator: Ava Patel
description: Summary: On 2026-02-14 we observed a cluster-wide regression affecting a subset of quantized model variants. Symptoms included sudden token-level accuracy drift for multi-turn chat workloads and crash loops for several GPU shards under bursty concurrent traffic. The incident caused elevated error rates and degradation for customers using int4/int8 packed-weight serving on the hosted API. This ticket captures the timeline, root cause analysis, immediate mitigations, and the set of action items to prevent recurrence.
timeline: 2026-02-14T02:12Z - First SLO alert: tail latency spike + increased 5xxs on quantized model pool (hosted-eu-west-1).
2026-02-14T02:18Z - Ops runbook executed: routed 20% traffic away from quantized pool; transient reduction in 5xxs but accuracy drift persisted for canary traffic.
2026-02-14T03:05Z - Pager duty: on-call eng + quant team assigned. Initial rollback of the most recent packaging change rolled out to a small subset of nodes; crashes reduced but drift remained.

2026-02-14T05:30Z - Investigation: noticed mismatch between packed-weight loader (little-endian) and a new conversion path introduced in packaging pipeline (big-endian) for a subset of models produced after 2026-02-01.

2026-02-14T06:10Z - Reproducer: deterministic token-probability divergence found when running deterministic sampling against model_v2_quant-packed build. Root reproducer included mis-ordered bytes for scale & bias tables used in int4 dequantization.
2026-02-14T08:00Z - Emergency mitigation: enabled automatic fallback to float32 variant for models with pack-metadata mismatch; restart policy adjusted to avoid crash loops (backoff increased).
2026-02-15T09:00Z - Incident declared: cross-functional postmortem started; log aggregation, diff of packaging commits and CI artifacts initiated.
2026-02-16T14:00Z - Hotfix branch created: explicit header/versioning & magic-number check added to pack loader; on-disk converter and CI checks in progress.
2026-02-20T16:00Z - Canary rollouts configured: 5% of traffic to converted models with strict sampling tests; monitoring dashboards and token-level regression alerts added.
2026-02-24T10:00Z - PRs for conversion and runtime detection opened: GH PRs #1834, #1847.
impact_summary: Affected ~3% of hosted quant payloads during the 6-hour window. Customers using quant-packed model builds saw periodic accuracy regressions (top-1/top-3 shift) and some pods entered crash-restart loops under concurrency bursts, impacting throughput and causing transient 5xx spikes. No data exfiltration or customer data loss observed.
root_cause: A packaging refactor (pack-v2) changed the endianness used when serializing per-channel scale/bias tables for packed int4/int8 weights. The runtime loader assumed the older endianness. The mismatch led to incorrect dequantized values for a subset of weight partitions. Under certain sequence lengths and beam/search params, those small value errors propagated into token-probability perturbations (accuracy drift). Additionally, an alignment/unaligned-read path combined with a new IO batching optimization caused intermittent invalid memory accesses under high concurrency, producing crash loops on affected shards.
mitigations_deployed: Enabled immediate fallback: traffic steering to float32 variants for impacted models (partial traffic shift completed within 1 hour).
Increased restart backoff and disabled aggressive IO batching on quantized pool to stop crash loops.
Introduced pack-file header detection: runtime now verifies magic bytes and endianness at load time and rejects incompatible files (fast-fail).
Deployed on-call canary with token-level sampling to detect accuracy regression earlier.
Customer comms: support bulletin posted and targeted emails sent to the small set of affected enterprise customers.
action_items: (A1) Implement stable pack header schema with version and endianness fields + unit tests — OWNER: Diego Martinez — ETA: 2026-03-03 — PR: #1834

(A2) Build on-disk conversion tool that upgrades legacy packed files safely (no-model-change path) and add to model onboarding pipeline — OWNER: Priya Rao — ETA: 2026-03-10 — TASK: add to ingestion CI
(A3) Add fuzzer & CI integration to catch endianness/format mismatches during packaging (nightly job) — OWNER: Kofi Mensah — ETA: 2026-03-08
(A4) Backport header-detection and safe-fallback to runtime-1.22 and runtime-1.23 branches and publish hotfix to Dedicated pools — OWNER: Maya Thompson — ETA: 2026-03-12
(A5) Create deterministic regression suite (token-level delta checks) for quant vs float variants and wire into canary gating — OWNER: Diego Martinez + SRE — ETA: 2026-03-01
(A6) Update model onboarding docs: require pack version bump and CI sign-off before promoting to hosted — OWNER: Olivia Kim (PM) — ETA: 2026-03-05
(A7) Add runtime metric(s) and alerting: pack-load-failures, pack-version-mismatch-rate, per-model token-delta anomalies — OWNER: SRE (Jin Park) — ETA: 2026-02-28 (alerts live)
(A8) Post-incident customer RCA and FAQ for affected customers; coordinate refunds/credits where appropriate — OWNER: Customer Success (Lina Gomez) — ETA: 2026-03-04
(A9) Follow-up postmortem review with Product & Design to evaluate if model card metadata should surface pack-version compatibility — OWNER: Emily Rivera (PM) — ETA: 2026-03-18
postmortem_status: RCA drafted and reviewed; header+converter fix PR in review; canary sampling & alerting in production. Tracking remaining action items; customer comms completed for known impacted customers. Postmortem review scheduled for 2026-03-02.
